checks.detail: Magnesium: estimated daily amount 200 mg; adult UL 350 mg; this appears below the UL. UL applies to supplemental magnesium (and medications), not naturally occurring food intake.
Folate: a UL reference exists (1000 mcg), but this product dose could not be safely compared. UL applies to folic acid from supplements or fortified foods, not naturally occurring food folate.
NAC: no NIH ODS upper limit is established for this ingredient.
